description: IMF Special Drawing Rights (SDR) valuation for the latest IMF business day: the five basket currencies (US dollar, euro, Chinese yuan, Japanese yen, UK pound) with the currency amount under Rule O-1, market exchange rate, US-dollar equivalent and % change; plus the SDR value in US dollars (SDR1 = US$) and the US dollar in SDR (US$1 = SDR). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
